setup.title: Setup
setup.brand_welcome_sub: We'll guide you through everything you need.
setup.brand_documents_sub: We'll find the relevant information automatically.
setup.brand_governance_sub: Based on your industry, we suggest what matters most.
setup.brand_payroll_sub: Tariffs and supplements set up per current agreements.
setup.brand_employment_sub: Standard terms following Norwegian labour law.
setup.brand_team_sub: Everyone starts with training tailored to their role.
setup.brand_shifts_sub: Templates based on opening hours and experience data.
setup.brand_season_sub: Budget and staffing in one place.
setup.brand_handbook_sub: Ready to use from day one.

steps.welcome_explanation: We'll set up your workplace step by step. It takes about 10 minutes.
steps.document-drop_explanation: Upload shift lists, contracts, pay agreements, or other documents. We'll find the relevant information automatically.
steps.governance_explanation: Guidelines contain action plans, training, and verification. Whenever you want to maintain a standard, Smartout builds a control for it.
steps.payroll_explanation: Configure tariff agreements, supplements, and basic payroll settings.
steps.employment_explanation: Define standard employment terms for new employees.
steps.team_explanation: Add employees and send invitations. They'll receive automatic training based on their role.
steps.shift-template_explanation: Define shift templates based on opening hours and needs.
steps.season_explanation: Create and configure your first season with budget and staffing needs.
steps.handbook_explanation: We've created a draft based on the information you've provided. Review and adjust.

settings_hours.description: Default opening hours for your workspace. Departments inherit these unless they have their own adjustments.
settings_hours.not_saved_desc: The times below are defaults. Click Save to activate.

department_hours.title: Department adjustment
department_hours.description: Adjust opening hours relative to the workspace base.
